 01.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid
arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
Heard learned counsel for the parties.

The petitioner has filed this writ petition seeking for a direction to the opposite parties to adjudicate, sanction and pay the compensation amount in connection with the petition filed under section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 arising out of L.A.R. No.09 of 2017 and L.A.R. No.10 of 2017 pending before the Special Land Acquisition Officer, Lower Indra Irrigation Project, Khariar in the district of Nuapada, Opp. Party No.3.
In such background, he prays that a direction be issued to the Opp. Party No.3 to dispose of the said case expeditiously.

Considering the submission made and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, this Court disposes of the writ petition directing the Opp. Party No.3 to dispose of the 28-A application arising out of L.A.R. No.09 of 2017 and L.A.R. No.10 of 2017 in accordance with law within a period of three months from the date of production of certified copy of this order and communicate the result of such exercise to the petitioner.

It is further directed that in case the application of the petitioner under section 28-A of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 is allowed, and if there is no other legal impediment, the compensation amount be disbursed in favour of the petitioner within a period Niran Paharia @ Kamar vs State Of Odisha And ....
